---
question: How long can I keep a book?
short: Three weeks, unless someone else has asked for it.
related:
- renewing
---

A loan lasts three weeks. After that the book is [[overdue]], and the
[[Reading Room|reading room]] desk will write to you.

See [the lending rules](https://example.org/rules) or [contact us](/help/contact).

> To add: what happens over the summer.
